status: Discussion proposal, not a delivery commitment or measured effort assessment

tasks.title: Define and maintain product needs and requirements
tasks.outcome: A colleague turns source material into reviewed needs and testable requirements with supporting evidence and recorded decisions.
tasks.remains: People resolve domain ambiguity, independently inspect the evidence and decide what to accept.

subtasks.title: Interpret source material and agree the needs
subtasks.support: Capture exact passages, track clarification questions and produce cited candidate needs for review.

subtasks.title: Derive and review testable requirements
subtasks.support: Draft requirements from reviewed needs, check and revise them, and separately review their proposed links.

subtasks.title: Maintain accepted versions and trace coverage
subtasks.support: Retain decisions and versions, inspect defined coverage gaps and retrieve the accepted records.

conditional.when: Risk controls supply requirement inputs.
User-task and usability evidence supplies requirement inputs.

enhancements.when: Add document extraction or selected live source capture.
Add missing-link suggestions or ongoing drift detection.

tasks.title: Assess and manage product risks
tasks.outcome: A risk reviewer maintains risks and controls, inspects their supporting evidence and records a residual-risk decision.
tasks.remains: Domain experts analyse hazards, judge control effectiveness and make the risk decision. Record support does not automate that judgement.

subtasks.title: Analyse hazards, define controls and assess residual risk
subtasks.support: Maintain or reference risk analyses, assumptions, controls, supporting evidence and named decisions.

subtasks.title: Review evidence of implementation and effectiveness
subtasks.support: Connect control requirements to implementation and reviewed test executions, with evidence gaps visible.

subtasks.title: Maintain links and coordinate risk-related updates
subtasks.support: Review risk-to-requirement/test links, trace known change consequences and assign follow-up.

conditional.when: Use-related risk evidence is relevant.
Validation results support the risk decision.
Model or dataset evidence is relevant.

enhancements.when: Suggest relationships missing from the recorded graph.

tasks.title: Design and evaluate how people use the product
tasks.outcome: A colleague follows a critical user task through UI requirements, relevant risks, study findings and resulting actions.
tasks.remains: People design the interface, conduct studies and interpret the findings. The tool organises the evidence and review workflow.

subtasks.title: Interpret study findings and decide what changes
subtasks.support: Reference study versions, review the evidence and record owned changes arising from the findings.

subtasks.title: Define critical tasks, UI requirements and controls
subtasks.support: Maintain task identities and draft/review UI requirements using selected task context.

subtasks.title: Connect tasks, evaluations and follow-up
subtasks.support: Inspect task-to-requirement/evaluation coverage and retain the links and decisions.

conditional.when: Critical tasks involve use-related risks and controls.
The usability evaluation also supports validation of a need or claim.

tasks.title: Demonstrate that implementation meets requirements
tasks.outcome: A reviewer follows a requirement through design, an exact build, test execution and the recorded disposition of its result.
tasks.remains: Engineers implement the product and execute tests. People investigate failures and judge whether the evidence is sufficient.

subtasks.title: Review results, investigate failures and decide follow-up
subtasks.support: Preserve executions and anomalies, independently review results and assign updates or retesting.

subtasks.title: Define verification plans and acceptance criteria
subtasks.support: Maintain plans at the selected test level, link criteria to checked items and inspect coverage gaps.

subtasks.title: Connect exact builds, executions and supporting evidence
subtasks.support: Associate requirements/design with code/build references and the relevant test configurations and results.

conditional.when: Tests verify risk-control implementation or effectiveness.
The build includes a model with dataset-specific evidence.

enhancements.when: Capture tracker, repository or CI evidence automatically.
Add checks in normal developer work and drift review.

tasks.title: Demonstrate that the product meets needs and supports claims
tasks.outcome: A reviewer can explain which evaluation evidence supports a need or claim, for which product configuration, and with what limitations.
tasks.remains: People design and conduct evaluations, collect new evidence and decide whether conclusions are justified.

subtasks.title: Interpret results, limitations and unresolved gaps
subtasks.support: Organise results per need/claim, independently inspect supporting evidence and record conclusions or follow-up.

subtasks.title: Define evaluation plans and criteria
subtasks.support: Maintain or reference protocols, population/scenario scope and the exact evaluation configuration.

subtasks.title: Maintain the evidence basis of each conclusion
subtasks.support: Retain evidence links and decisions, identify defined coverage gaps and relate the evaluated product version.

conditional.when: Usability evaluation supplies validation evidence.
Model/data evidence supports a need or claim.
The result requires reconsidering a risk decision.

tasks.title: Review and coordinate product changes
tasks.outcome: A quality colleague reviews a proposed change, sees known impacts and missing context, and coordinates owned updates and reviews.
tasks.remains: People inspect consequences beyond recorded links, confirm impacts and perform the required product updates and tests.

subtasks.title: Determine impacts, including missing relationships
subtasks.support: Assemble relevant evidence, explain known impact paths and provide an independent review path beyond the graph.

subtasks.title: Coordinate updates, retesting and reviews
subtasks.support: Assign follow-up with owners, reasons and outcomes, then review changed relationships.

subtasks.title: Record the change and disposition its findings
subtasks.support: Retain old/proposed states, scope and review decisions against exact versions.

conditional.when: Risk records or controls are affected.
Implementation or verification evidence is affected.
User tasks or usability evidence are affected.
Needs/claim evaluation evidence is affected.
Labels or instructions are affected. Applicable risk and claim evidence is also needed.
Models or datasets are affected.

enhancements.when: Trigger review from live changes and checks in developer work.

tasks.title: Prepare reviewed evidence, documents and release decisions
tasks.outcome: A colleague agrees an exact evidence baseline and produces a reviewable document. Label authoring and release readiness are additional scoped workflows.
tasks.remains: People resolve substantive evidence issues and make distinct baseline, document, risk and release decisions. Document generation alone does not establish readiness.

subtasks.title: Resolve inconsistencies and outstanding evidence issues
subtasks.support: Gather evidence, inspect defined gaps, independently review it and record owned corrections.

subtasks.title: Assemble and review selected documents
subtasks.support: Generate an identifiable specification/report from agreed baseline membership and review completeness.

subtasks.title: Record an agreed baseline and its decisions
subtasks.support: Retain exact evidence/link versions and a distinct baseline decision. Add release decisions only when release scope is selected.

conditional.when: Author labels with relevant risk disclosures and supported claims.
Add release support with applicable risk and validation evidence; exact build/test evidence is a prerequisite.
Usability evidence is required in the selected output or release.
Model/dataset evidence is part of the selected output or release.

tasks.title: Manage model and dataset evidence where applicable
tasks.outcome: A reviewer can connect exact model/data versions to the product build, performance evidence and the consequences of a proposed change.
tasks.remains: Specialists train models, prepare datasets, run evaluations and judge performance and data adequacy.

subtasks.title: Assess the consequences of model/data changes
subtasks.support: Reference model/data evidence, trace recorded impacts and retain independent review findings and owned follow-up.

subtasks.title: Assemble evidence for the exact model and build
subtasks.support: Associate model/data identities with build references and reviewed test/evaluation evidence.

subtasks.title: Maintain version identities and provenance
subtasks.support: Reference dataset origins, partitions, training configuration and the artifact used by each build.

conditional.when: Model performance or data changes affect risk decisions.
Model evaluation supports product needs or claims.

enhancements.when: Automatically capture relevant repository and CI evidence.

roadmap.title: Review needs and requirements
roadmap.outcome: A representative transcript becomes independently checked, human-reviewed needs and requirements with citations and saved decisions.
roadmap.saving: Less source copying, first-draft preparation and reconstruction of review history.
roadmap.boundary: Start with plain text and selected context. People clarify, revise and accept the outputs. Live capture can follow.

roadmap.title: Review one significant product change
roadmap.outcome: A quality colleague reviews a defined change across known requirements, risk/control references and test evidence, then assigns owned follow-up.
roadmap.saving: Less evidence hunting and manual reconstruction of known impact paths and action lists.
roadmap.boundary: Use a prepared evidence bundle initially. P-R starts with risk/control records and references; broad hazard-authoring assistance and automated unlinked-impact search are further scope.

roadmap.title: Connect implementation, tests and controls
roadmap.outcome: Reviewers can follow requirements and controls to exact builds, reviewed test executions and anomalies, with follow-up recorded.
roadmap.saving: Less manual reconciliation of build/test identities, control evidence and review status.
roadmap.boundary: Choose a bounded test level and report format first. Test execution and failure investigation remain engineering activities. Adapters are separate increments.

roadmap.title: Add selected specialist evaluations
roadmap.outcome: Extend the same review approach to critical tasks, needs/claims or model/data evidence, according to the product scope.
roadmap.saving: Less effort joining study findings and performance evidence to the records and decisions they support.
roadmap.boundary: Select usability, validation and model/data branches independently. Each needs its own evidence examples and acceptance check. Conducting studies and evaluations remains outside record support.

roadmap.title: Produce reviewed evidence outputs
roadmap.outcome: A colleague selects exact evidence versions, records a baseline decision and produces a reviewed specification or report.
roadmap.saving: Less repeated document assembly and version reconciliation.
roadmap.boundary: Document production can start earlier from a usable baseline. Label authoring and release support require their own evidence scope and distinct decisions; they are not included in this document increment.
